# Verdens mest omtalte sidespring fylder i finans

**Feed**: millionaerklubben  
**Published**: 2026-11-13  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This is a Danish Millionærklubben listener Q&A episode, so the companies are mostly Danish and Nordic. The hosts avoid Nvidia and chip stocks because they expect US data-center projects to be delayed or cancelled. They see Nordic medtech recovering: Elekta looks like a technical buy and Embla Medical a long-term buy-and-hold. They prefer Zealand Pharma to the richly priced ALK, would wait for lower prices in Maersk and ABB, and suggest protecting SkiStar's gains with a trailing stop. The mood is mixed, with caution on AI and tech and selective optimism on healthcare and leisure names.

---

## Universe Stocks

### ⛔ NVDA — Nvidia | **AVOID** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 70%

Hosts would not buy. Chip stocks are in a downtrend and data-center build-outs are at risk.

#### Reasoning

Lars Persson would not dream of buying. The technical guest notes chip makers are trending down. New US politicians and local opposition could delay data centers and shrink full order books. He wants to wait and see who wins.

#### Sell Triggers

- chip sector trend reversal upward
- evidence that data-center orders are holding

> *"Jeg kunne ikke drømme om at købe den."*

---

### 🟢 EKTA-B — Elekta | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 65%

Technically a buy. Resistance at 65; a breakout could run toward its earlier 130 high.

#### Reasoning

Medtech has more tailwind. Elekta has cleaned up after a loss and new launches should show up in results within 2-5 months. The chart has been trying to break 65. The stock trades near 62.

#### Sell Triggers

- failure to break 65 resistance
- new product launches not showing up in results
- uptrend breaks

> *"Så den ser spændende ud, og den er faktisk i køb. Modstandsniveauet er 65."*

---

### 🟢 ZEAL — Zealand Pharma | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 70%

Host owns many shares and says the story is intact. Trades near cash value. The technical guest awaits a buy signal.

#### Reasoning

Lars has high expectations: the obesity drug with Boehringer and the SBS drug are undervalued, and the shares are covered by cash. He floats swapping ALK for Zealand, stressing this is not advice. The technical guest has moved it to the front of his watchlist after it held around 230.

#### Sell Triggers

- pipeline setbacks
- break below the ~230 support

> *"C-Land er et selskab, jeg har meget store forventninger til, og den handles jo til cash."*

---

### 🟡 ALK-B — ALK-Abelló | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Business is going well but the stock is more than fully priced. Host kept only his core holding.

#### Reasoning

The allergy tablets are expanding, but the P/E is high. Buyers appear around 200 and sellers near 270. Lars suggests possibly rotating most of the position into Zealand.

#### Sell Triggers

- valuation stretched further
- weak results near 270 resistance

> *"Og det går sådan set godt, men den er mere end rigeligt betalt."*

---

### 🟠 KIT — Kitron | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Neutral | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 45%

Take the 20% employee discount. At market prices, wait. Support around 82.

#### Reasoning

Supplier of industrial and defence electronics. The chart shows lower tops since May-June, but support is solid above 82. The guest would put it on the watchlist and wait.

#### Sell Triggers

- break below 82 support

> *"Så jeg tror, jeg vil lige vente lidt og se, hvad der sker med aktien det næste stykke tid."*

---

### 🟠 MAERSK-B — A.P. Møller-Mærsk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Host would buy only around 17,000 and sees fair value near 25,000. Has trimmed half of his extra shares.

#### Reasoning

Conditions are good now thanks to a capacity shortage. Reopening the Suez and Aden routes would add 5-6% supply, and a US-China breakdown would hurt containers. Barclays (analyst) cut to underweight with a 17,500 target.

#### Sell Triggers

- Suez/Red Sea route reopens
- US-China trade relations deteriorate

> *"Jeg vil sige 17, hvis jeg skulle købe."*

---

### 🟠 ABB — ABB | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Drifting lower around 840. Might start fishing near 750.

#### Reasoning

Order books are thick but grid and power capacity constrain delivery. The robotics sale was blocked by China. The technical guest would wait for a pullback to the earlier 740-750 level.

#### Sell Triggers

- further slide below 740

> *"Så kan det være, at vi skal begynde at fiske lidt i den. Men det vil jeg holde øje med."*

---

### 🟡 SKIS-B — SkiStar | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Let the winner run with a trailing stop 8-15% below. Consider taking partial profit.

#### Reasoning

Strong results from airport and slope investments and year-round revenue. P/E is about 25 and bookings are good ahead of the season. The guest would lock in gains with a stop rather than sell outright.

#### Sell Triggers

- price falls 8-15% from current levels
- poor snow season

> *"Så jeg vil jo sætte et eller andet stop-loss på 10-15 procent under, og så måske lade vinderen løbe yderligere op"*

---

### 🟢 EMBLA — Embla Medical | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 80%

Host bought near 27 after the price halved. Buy and keep for years.

#### Reasoning

Defensive prosthetics leader driven by ageing and diabetes. Management is sensible and new treatments such as leg orthoses are coming. Ukraine peace could lift demand. The host thinks it is near the bottom at 25-30 and expects it could double.

#### Sell Triggers

- organic growth keeps decelerating
- margin guidance cut further

> *"Så jo, køb og gem"*

---

### 🟢 TTWO — Take-Two Interactive | **BUY** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Speculative trade into the GTA release on 19 November. Already up from 190 to 226; resistance at 260.

#### Reasoning

The technical guest says speculating is possible but the stock has already risen a lot. The host cautions that new games can flop.

#### Sell Triggers

- fails at 260 resistance
- GTA launch disappoints

> *"Jamen, det kan man da godt spekulere i."*

---

### 🟡 HLUN-B — Lundbeck | **HOLD** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Strong fundamentals and cash flow. Technically strong, but it may consolidate after the sharp run.

#### Reasoning

Host likes Vyepti, Brintellix and the strong cash flow. The foundation's acquisitiveness is the main worry. The incoming chair is seen as positive. The technical guest sees buy signals but fears a pullback after the hockey-stick move.

#### Sell Triggers

- value-destroying acquisition by the foundation
- patent expiries hit revenue

> *"Så der er signaler og det hele Så der er ikke noget at være bange for"*

---

### 🟠 DEMANT — Demant | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 45%

The 8% drop looks like a short-term overreaction. Keep an eye on it after the 57% year-to-date run.

#### Reasoning

The guest thinks a large player took profit. The host has trimmed and notes a well-known trader sold out; it may be time for a pause.

#### Sell Triggers

- further weakness after the drop

> *"Man skal i hvert fald holde øje med den, men jeg tror måske, at det på kort sigt, det var en overreaktion."*

---

### 🟡 GN — GN Store Nord | **HOLD** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

Host still views the Amplifon deal as good but took some profit after the move from 104 to about 121.

#### Reasoning

The deal gives GN a roughly 10% Amplifon stake and frees cash. After the gain the host trimmed his extra shares and kept his core position.

#### Sell Triggers

- Amplifon deal fails to close

> *"Det mener jeg stadigvæk er en god ting"*

---
